 The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name. 
 Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. 
 If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you. 
 The Role 
 We are looking for a  Lead Recruiter (Commercial & Corporate Hiring)  to lead hiring across Operations, Finance, Marketing, Creative, HR, Legal, Strategy, CEO Office, and other corporate functions globally. 
 This role combines hands-on recruitment execution with leadership responsibilities. You will partner closely with business leaders to attract high-impact talent, drive hiring strategy, and help build a scalable Talent Acquisition function capable of supporting BJAK’s rapid global growth. 
 You will play a critical role in shaping the organization by hiring exceptional talent while mentoring junior recruiters and establishing recruiting best practices across the business. 
 What You’ll Do 
 Business Recruitment Leadership 
 
 
 Own the end-to-end recruitment process for business and corporate functions globally, including Operations, Finance, Marketing, Creative, HR, Legal, CEO Office, and other key functions. 
 
 
 Partner closely with hiring managers and senior leaders to define hiring priorities, organizational needs, role requirements, and workforce planning strategies. 
 
 
 Act as a trusted talent advisor by providing market intelligence, compensation insights, hiring recommendations, and talent market trends. 
 
 
 Lead recruitment efforts for senior, niche, confidential, and business-critical positions across multiple regions. 
 
 
 Develop and execute creative sourcing strategie

raw_description: Senior Manager, BiTE® Portfolio Marketing & Operations at Amgen.   Career Category  Marketing  Job Description    Role Overview    The Senior Marketing Manager, BiTE® Portfolio Marketing & Operations, will help shape how  Amgen  commercializes and supports successful implementation of the portfolio across healthcare settings. In this dual Senior Marketing Manager and Field Operations lead role, you will support portfolio-level marketing strategy and execution across  Amgen ’s approved and anticipated BiTE® therapies, including IMDELLTRA, BLINCYTO, and prostate cancer asset. The successful candidate brings pharmaceutical marketing experience, strong cross-functional leadership, and the ability to turn strategy into clear, effective execution in a complex, matrixed environment. This position will serve as a key connector between brand-created marketing strategy and field execution. The candidate would be tasked with translating brand priorities, customer insights, customer educational needs, and field insights into coordinated marketing initiatives and scalable resources. The role will help coordinate alignment across BiTE® therapies while addressing the distinct operational education considerations associated with each product.

We can offer a higher rate depending on your recruiting experience, sourcing skills and overall qualifications.  ABOUT US  We're expanding our recruiting team to support a premium household staffing client. That client places nannies, housekeepers, family assistants and household managers with private families in the U.S.  ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY  We're looking for a Recruiter to help our client find trustworthy, experienced household professionals. This isn't corporate or BPO volume hiring. Each placement goes into someone's home and usually involves caring for their children, so judgment, follow-through and careful screening matter more than speed alone. The client's standard is warm, polished and high-touch, and that applies to how candidates are treated as well as families.  You'll work alongside a senior recruiter and get hands-on training in sourcing, screening and AI-assisted recruiting tools.  WHAT YOU'LL DO  
 Source nannies, housekeepers, family assistants and household managers through Indeed, LinkedIn, Care.com, local community groups, referrals and our candidate database. 
 Write and post job ads that reflect each family's needs: schedule, duties, household style and location. 
 Screen candidates by phone or video for experience, availability, reliability, commute and pay expectations. 
 Dig into childcare and household experience: ages cared for, length of past placements, certifications (e.g., CPR/First Aid) and driving requirements. 
 Run thorough reference checks with past families and employers, and coordinate background checks. 
 Schedule interviews and trial days between candidates and families. 
 Keep candidate records, notes and pipeline stages up to date in Manatal (ATS). 
 Keep candidates informed and engaged throughout the process with a warm, professional tone. 
 Track daily and weekly activity such as outreach, screens, references completed and submittals. 
 Handle family and candidate information with complete discretion and follow fair, equal-opportunity hiring practices. 
  MUST HAVE  
 1–2 years of recruiting experience, including recruiting for U.S.-based roles or clients. 
 Experience recruiting nannies, caregivers, housekeepers, domestic staff or hospitality workers. 
 Excellent written and spoken English, with a warm and polished communication style. 
 Comfortable calling candidates and references you don't know, and able to ask

raw_description:
Senior Machine Learning Engineer, FeedForward 3D/4D Reconstruction at Paralleldomain.  At Parallel Domain, we believe that autonomous systems – from self-driving cars to contactless delivery drones – have the opportunity to drastically improve the quality of life for billions of people. That is why we love what we do: enabling our customers to develop their technology safely using the Parallel Domain data generation platform. Our platform revolutionizes the way our customers generate sensor data for AI development. We're looking for people like you to join us in pushing the boundaries of artificial intelligence and synthetic data.     About the role  
 Before any physical AI system is trusted in the real world, it has to prove itself in ours. Parallel Domain turns real captured drives into faithful digital replicas — geometry, appearance and motion that perception stacks are trained and validated against. 
   
 We are hiring a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to push our feed-forward reconstruction stack forward — from static 3D toward full 4D scenes over time. You will join a small, deep team where your technical judgment carries real weight from day one, and your work will ship in a pipeline customers depend on.   What You'll Do  
  Advance our feed-forward reconstruction models . Improve how we predict geometry, camera pose and appearance from real capture with transformer-based models, and extend it from static scenes to dynamic 4D. 
  Train at scale . Run multi-node GPU training on large multi-view and video datasets, and decide what to scale, what to ablate and when a result is real. 
  Define what "good" means . Build evaluation the team trusts for reconstruction quality, temporal consistency and geometric accuracy. 
  Explore stronger priors . Investigate where generative models, such as pre-trained video diffusion, can help fill gaps the capture did not see. 
  Land research in the product . Work with the pipeline engineers to get results into production, and care whether they hold up there. 
  Track the field . This area moves monthly; form a view on where it is heading and argue for it. 
  What we're looking for  
  Hands-on feed-forward reconstruction experience . You have built or trained feedforward 3D reconstruction models (for example in the lineage of DUSt3R, VGGT, π³ or D4RT), and you know where they work and where they break. 
  A track record of models others relied on . We weight demonstrated depth over years served : a recent PhD with the right focus and an experienced research engineer are both credible

Senior Frontend Engineer - React at Researchgate.  
 ResearchGate is the professional network for scientists and researchers. From climate change and emerging diseases to food security and the responsible development of AI, the challenges facing our world are complex. Still, we’re optimistic about the power of millions of scientists working together to tackle them. We provide scientists with the help and support they need by connecting them to the world’s most active scientific community. 
 We've built a platform that gives the world's scientists the tools and services they need to connect, collaborate, and advance their research. Over 25 million members from 193 countries use ResearchGate to share, discover, and discuss research. 
   Objective of the role   
 We're looking for an enthusiastic frontend engineer with the skills and ability to turn great ideas into reality. You should have an in-depth understanding of current web technologies and front-end development, and be passionate about creating a great user experience. Your input will help us grow and maintain our React front-end. 
 Join a team that encourages you to explore, learn, and go beyond, while seeing your work lead to actionable results. Put your creative problem-solving and development skills into action and make a positive impact on science and society. This is a full-time position based in Germany. 
   The team    
 You will be an integral part of the product team dedicated to enhancing ResearchGate's publisher-facing product. This role involves designing, constructing, and refining the platform to further our mission of facilitating global scientific connections and ensuring open access to research. At present, our team is working on making ResearchGate a great platform for publishers to connect with existing and future authors. 
 Your immediate colleagues will consist of JavaScript and PHP engineers, an Engineering Manager, a Product Manager, a UX Designer, and a UX Writer. Our team places great value on our collaborative and communicative work culture and we eagerly anticipate integrating a new Engineer into this environment. 
   Responsibilites    

 
 Create web interfaces using TypeScript and React for new products and features. 
 
 
 Seamlessly integrate our front-end with our back-end world using GraphQL and PHP. 
 
 
 Maintain and improve existing features and related infrastructure. 
 
 
 Collaborate with Product Managers, Designers, and Software Engineers to deliver compelling publisher-facing products. 
 

   Requirements
